desc: Ideation: identify that zero-containing numbers are automatically beautiful and that only no-zero numbers with digit sum not dividing digit product are bad.
Implement the compact code-only digit-DP solution with tuple exponent state, caps `(6,4,2,2)`, precomputed digit/sum exponent requirements, zero pruning, and final range formula.
Verify the implementation by executing sample tests and brute-force comparisons for small ranges, including single digits, 10/20, 1/15, 11/22/25, zero-containing numbers, and max-range sanity checks.
